items.name: SSL-RUL — Self-Supervised Predictive Maintenance
items.description: SSL-RUL introduces a self-supervised pretraining strategy for Remaining Useful Life (RUL) prediction in industrial machinery. The model uses masked sensor reconstruction as a pretext task, followed by fine-tuning on minimal labeled degradation data. Evaluated on NASA C-MAPSS FD001-FD004 datasets with state-of-the-art RMSE and Score metrics. Currently under review at Results in Engineering (Elsevier). Developed in collaboration with researchers at VIT Chennai CSE department.
items.reported_outcome: Paper Under Review. 48.6% RMSE improvement on C-MAPSS with reduced labeled data.

items.name: GIL — Geometric Information Learner
items.description: GIL (Geometric Information Learner) is a published Python ML package that applies information geometry principles to tabular learning. Implements Riemannian manifold-aware gradient descent, Fisher information matrix regularization, and Information Bottleneck imputation for missing data. Offers a scikit-learn compatible API for drop-in integration. Includes comprehensive test suite, CI/CD pipeline via GitHub Actions, and pre-commit hooks. Addresses fundamental geometric structure of data distributions that standard Euclidean-space models ignore.

items.name: Synthetic Taphonomic Deformation — Paleontological AI
items.description: This research pipeline processes 3D CT slice stacks of fossil specimens (8 specimens x 30 projections = 240 images per specimen) via orthographic maximum intensity projection (MIP) and rotational view generation. Outputs are used to train a deep learning Taphonomic Distortion Estimator that predicts morphological deformation caused by sedimentary burial. Implemented with ASCII-safe encoding for cross-platform Windows/Linux compatibility. Collaborative paleontological research project at VIT Chennai.
